feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 August 2026 9:48pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 30 August 2026 at 9:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred off the west coast of Ireland tracks eastwards, bringing various frontal troughs across the area.


##Wind##

Mainly southerly but cyclonic in places 2 to 4, settling west or northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 later in the night. Decreasing 3 or 4 occasionally 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time later in the night and tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, some heavy at times, becoming mainly fair tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, occasionally 5, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair. Then outbreaks of rain arriving from the west overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but falling moderate or poor in rain later.
